WoW: Forever

Frost Mage

Freeze the target, then hit it for four times the damage (+300%). Icy Veins: "with FrostbiteFrostbiteTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec., melee enemies will often not even reach you before killing them."

Back to top

Written for the live game, levels 1 to 60, as of the November 12 hotfixes. Numbers are the client's, read with its hotfixes. The talent order is Icy Veins' published one, dated, and it replays legally on the current tree; Wowhead's levelling build is described from its own text. Rotation reasoning that cites WoWSims is a model's, and says so. The level 60 material was published before any raid opened, so none of it rests on a raid log. Blizzard's hotfix posts since launch list no change to a Frost spell or talent. Where a spell's tooltip disagrees with the text here, trust the text: tooltips can lag behind a hotfix. Blizzard's one-point milestone talents sit at 11, 16, 21 and 31 points, so Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownDeals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. can be yours at 20, Ice BlockIce BlockLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost15 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secYou become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. at 25 and Ice BarrierIce BarrierLevel 40 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost305 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration60 secShield yourself, absorbing 448 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 60 sec. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage. at 40.

What Frost is for

FrostbiteFrostbiteTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec. 3/3 gives every Chill effect you apply a 15% chance to freeze the target. Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownDeals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. is instant, on an 8-second cooldown, and hits a frozen target for +300%. ShatterShatterTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%. 3/3 then adds 50% crit against that frozen target for three points. From 30, Fingers of FrostFingers of FrostTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec. gives the same bonuses against targets that cannot be frozen.

Icy Veins rates it 4/5 for levelling, under the heading "Smooth and Steady"; the score measures solo kill speed, and Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish none. Its verdict: "Frost Mages are going to have a comfortable time leveling… slowing and chilling everything they fight keeps them safe."

The drawback, in the same source's words, is "the constant need to stop for mana". You will drink often. Icy Veins also says Frost "doesn't become fully effective until level 30+", and offers levelling as Arcane first and respeccing at about 31 as an option.

On damage the published line is "Frost Mage won't top the damage meters, but few specs are as safe or as consistent."

In dungeons Icy Veins scores it 4/5. You bring Cone of ColdCone of ColdLevel 26 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost210 ManaCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration6 secTargets in a cone in front of the caster take 96 to 106 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec. and BlizzardBlizzardLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost320 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration8 secIce shards pelt the target area doing 196 Frost damage over 8 sec. for packs, and Ice BarrierIce BarrierLevel 40 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost305 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration60 secShield yourself, absorbing 448 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 60 sec. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage. and Ice BlockIce BlockLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost15 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secYou become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. for the moments you pull threat.

Stat priority

While levelling, Icy Veins' order is:

  1. Hit — "capping your Hit Chance is a high priority". Two points of PrecisionPrecisionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantImproves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%. cover same-level targets
  2. Spell Power (Frost) — scales every spell
  3. Critical strike — "Frost Mage is a crit-based spec": Ice ShardsIce ShardsTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%. doubles the crit-damage bonus at 5/5
  4. Spirit — "Frost Mages have limited tools for resource management, so Spirit will be a good stat to increase where you can"
  5. Intellect — a bigger mana pool for a whole pull, plus a small crit bonus
  6. Stamina — survival only

At 60 the two sites differ, and both call their lists provisional. Icy Veins: Hit to 17%, Spell Power, Critical strike, Intellect, MP5, Spirit. Wowhead: Hit, of which you need 11 to 12% from gear after talents, then Critical strike, Spell Damage, Intellect, Spirit, Stamina. The 17% is the miss chance against a raid boss.
